Special economic zones development & management

Advisory on developing, operating and managing free zones and special economic zones, including operations guidelines and related support.

Corporate consulting

Guidance on strategy, business structure and operations to help organisations improve performance and manage growth.

Corporate training

Capacity-building programmes for management and staff, shaped around organisational skills and performance needs.

Business guidance

Ongoing support for owners and managers facing regulatory, commercial and operational decisions.

Entrepreneur consultancy

Support for startups and growing businesses, including business planning, market entry and access-to-funding preparation.

Feasibility studies

Market potential, technical requirements, financial projections, regulatory frameworks and risk factors examined to support investment decisions.

Project development

Support taking a viable concept through structuring, documentation, approvals and implementation.

Investment facilitation

Developing investment proposals and connecting investors with relevant authorities, institutions and commercial stakeholders.

Specialist capabilities.

  • Government development funds: eligibility review, facilitation, report preparation and submission support.
  • Public-private partnerships: facilitation for investors and development institutions.
  • Advocacy consulting for the organised private sector.
  • Business development intelligence for clients and governments.
  • Manufacturing, marketing, supplies and engineering through partnerships with other groups.

Venture capital & corporate transactions

Our profile describes advisory experience involving venture capital investment, securities offerings, spinoffs, mergers and acquisitions, joint ventures and international agreements. Areas of support include business formation, finance, tax structuring, intellectual property and employment-related considerations.

How we work.

  1. Understand

    Clarify objectives, constraints and the sector and regulatory context.

  2. Assess

    Examine market, technical, financial and regulatory viability and risk.

  3. Structure

    Build the business case, documentation and approvals roadmap.

  4. Facilitate

    Liaise with authorities, partners and funders on the client’s behalf.

  5. Support

    Follow through to approval and setup with continued advisory support.
